limit_order_matching_in_progress.meaning: a limit order matching (partial or full) is being processed through _processLimitBidOrder or _processLimitAskOrder
limit_order_matching_in_progress.checkpoint: before the zero-cost trade guard is evaluated during limit order matching

matched_amounts_disjoint_bits.meaning: the matched base amount and matched quote amount have no overlapping 1-bits (e.g., base = 256 and quote in 1..255, or 40 & 21)
matched_amounts_disjoint_bits.checkpoint: before the zero-cost trade guard is evaluated during limit order matching

one_side_receives_without_sending.meaning: one side receives tokens without sending any (the genuine zero-cost trade condition the guard is intended to catch)
one_side_receives_without_sending.checkpoint: at zero-cost trade guard evaluation during limit order matching

zero_cost_guard_triggered.meaning: the zero-cost trade guard triggers (rejects the match)
zero_cost_guard_triggered.checkpoint: at zero-cost trade guard evaluation during limit order matching

legitimate_trade_fails_misleading_error.meaning: a legitimate trade fails with a misleading error, damaging user experience and market efficiency
legitimate_trade_fails_misleading_error.checkpoint: after zero-cost trade guard evaluation during limit order matching

assumptions: The zero-cost trade guard is the check whose triggering is governed by the stated intent.
The matched base and quote amounts are observable quantities at guard evaluation time.

unresolved.description: The report does not quote the exact zero-cost guard expression or its operands, so the guard-trigger relation is represented by grounded Boolean observables rather than a numeric expression.
Report does not specify whether matched amounts are caller-supplied inputs or derived from order state.

limitations: The intent's 'only when' is encoded as the guard triggering under the genuine zero-cost condition; the exclusion of disjoint-bit-only triggering is assessed by the post-generation audit against P and V.
Disjoint-bit relation is represented as a grounded Boolean because the report gives only illustrative numeric examples, not a single defining expression.
